We have fuelLevel 10 liters. Tank capacity 50 gallons? Wait earlier note: "The fuel tank can hold up to 50 gallons." That\'s in gallons. But we have fuelLevel in liters. Need to convert? The function expects fuelAmount in gallons. So we need to convert 10 liters to gallons. Use gallon_to_liter? Actually we want to fill to full. We need to know how many gallons to add. We have fuelLevel 10 liters. Convert to gallons: 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So 10 liters = 2.64172 gallons. Tank capacity 50 gallons. So need to add 47.35828 gallons. But maybe easier: just fill entire tank ignoring current level? The function fillFuelTank takes fuelAmount to add. We could just add 50 gallons? That would overfill. Better to add 50 - current gallons. Let\'s convert current fuel to gallons: 10 liters / 3.78541 = 2.642 gallons. So need 47.358 gallons. We\'ll round to 47.36 gallons. Then call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 47.36.')
